text.en:
Section twenty-three of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and ninety-three, known as the
Patent Law, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 23. The operation of the present Act is hereby suspended until January first, nineteen hundred and
twenty-two, until which date Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and thirty-five, entiltled 'An Act providing
for the registration of patents and patent rights in the Philippine Islands, and for protection of the same,' shall
continue in ful force and effect."
"Section 2. This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 22, 1920.
